title: Mine Has a Dinosaur
can_do: 用可见的特征辨认自己的物品，排除相似物品，并在核对后确认拿回。
trigger: At the end of the school day, Rabbit Teacher holds two similar blue bottles and asks whose they are; Child remembers picking his sticker on the first day.
setting: Collecting a water bottle at a quiet classroom table before going home.
essential_props: two light-blue bottles with cream caps: one green-dinosaur sticker and one yellow-star sticker

turns.speaker: teacher
turns.line: Two bottles are left. Whose are they?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Mine has a green dinosaur sticker.

turns.speaker: teacher
turns.line: How do you know it's yours?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: I picked the green dinosaur on the first day.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: That one is my friend's. She loves yellow stars.

turns.speaker: teacher
turns.line: Then the star bottle goes back to your friend.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: And my dinosaur bottle goes home with me.

replay_cards.title: Whose jacket?
replay_cards.setting: At the classroom coat hooks before outdoor play
replay_cards.change: Two jackets are red; Child's has a bear patch and the other is plain. Teacher hears the color but misses the feature and mistakenly reaches for the plain jacket.
replay_cards.challenge: When Teacher asks which jacket is his, Child explains: "Mine is red with a bear patch." As Teacher reaches for the plain jacket, Child corrects the choice: "No, mine has a bear patch." Teacher accepts the correction, checks the visible bear patch and returns that jacket. Child confirms it is his and puts it on.

replay_cards.title: Whose drawing?
replay_cards.setting: Clearing drawings from the family table
replay_cards.change: Child wants to keep his blue-boat picture. A red-sun drawing lies on top of it, leaving one blue corner visible.
replay_cards.challenge: Child tells Dad that his drawing has a blue boat and asks, "Is it under that picture?" Dad lifts the red-sun drawing to check. Child identifies the now-visible boat, confirms the lower drawing is his and takes it. Dad leaves the red-sun drawing on the table.

parent_support: Choose a feature that actually distinguishes the objects and show both objects while checking it.
Treat ownership as a calm joint check. Wait for the matching feature before handing the object over, and accept a correction without blame or grabbing.
